name: What factors influence the total cost of kitchen backsplash installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the total cost of kitchen backsplash installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends primarily on square footage, tile material, wall condition, and layout complexity. Basic ceramic or porcelain subway tiles cost significantly less than natural marble, handmade artisan tiles, or intricate glass mosaics. Labor costs shift based on pattern difficulty, as layouts like herringbone or chevron require substantially more precision cuts around electrical boxes and range hoods. Additionally, if tearing out an old tile backsplash damages the underlying drywall, the cost to patch or replace the drywall before tiling will factor into the total estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Total cost depends on square footage, material choice, drywall repair needs, and pattern complexity, with layouts like herringbone requiring more labor and cutting.
